scripts.copy:firefox: mkdir addon_firefox && cp -R addon/* addon_firefox && cp firefox/manifest.json ./addon_firefox/manifest.json
scripts.copy:chrome: mkdir addon_chrome && cp -R addon/* addon_chrome && cp chrome/manifest.json ./addon_chrome/manifest.json
scripts.copy:opera: mkdir addon_opera && cp -R addon/* addon_opera && cp opera/manifest.json ./addon_opera/manifest.json
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run copy-typograf && rollup -c
scripts.full: npm run build && npm run pack:firefox && npm run pack:opera && npm run pack:chrome
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
